title: Official FO (FO) Price Prediction 2026-2027
content: The price action of Official FO (FO) over the past year highlights the inherent volatility associated with the meme token sub-sector within the [Solana](/solana) ecosystem. With a 1-year historical high of $0.825135 and a recent 30-day low of $0.263130, the asset has experienced significant downward pressure, mirroring broader trends observed in speculative crypto assets. This analysis examines these movements under the current neutral market phase as of May 7, 2026.
